purpose: Retrospective inspection with same-hour realized city-proxy temperature and revised aggregate demand. Flags are investigation candidates, not confirmed incidents, causal effects, or operational alerts. 2025 has already been inspected in prior studies.
modelPolicy: Step1 basis and selection rule, fresh chronology: preprocessing/train 2021–2022, select on 2023, refit coefficients on 2021–2023, signed residual calibration 2024, exploratory review 2025. No rolling updates.
thresholdPolicy: Area-specific signed 0.005/0.995 residual quantiles. Display raw expected plus frozen median residual correction. Score signed deviation divided by its respective tail width; flag strictly above one. Not a probability or confidence interval.
supportPolicy: Complete finite pairs only; no filling. Temperature outside development observed min/max is unsupported and unscored. At least 95% pairs per split; calibration also needs 8000 supported hours and 300 UTC dates. Report season/day-type support without separate thresholds.
episodePolicy: Consecutive UTC flagged hours of the same sign; missing/unsupported/unflagged hours or a sign change break the episode. Rank by peak score, then timestamp. Retain all rows and episodes; show the first 20 for review.

peerPolicy.interpretation: Comparable observations, not confirmed normal controls; no relaxation when unmatched.

syntheticValidation.report: Clean known-no-event false flags/episodes separately from injected event detection, affected-hour recall, and unaffected-window flags; observed real data have no true-normal labels.
